sources.title: Bounded search: other clients
sources.locator: grep over src/, src-tauri/src, sidecar/src, apps for linux appimage, deb, rpm, ios app, android app, vsix, vscode extension, jetbrains
sources.finding: No Linux build, native mobile app or editor extension; companion is a browser client.

sources.title: Bounded search: other harnesses
sources.locator: grep for gemini, aider, antigravity, grok, goose, amp, copilot cli across sidecar/src and src-tauri/src/agents
sources.finding: Agent adapters exist only for Claude, Codex, Cursor, Kimi and OpenCode; no generic adapter for arbitrary CLIs.

sources.title: Bounded search: telemetry
sources.locator: grep for sentry, posthog, analytics, telemetry, amplitude, umami across src, src-tauri/src, sidecar/src, Cargo.toml, package.json
sources.finding: No analytics or crash-reporting client found; only update checks and an explicit feedback feature.

sources.title: Bounded search: collaboration and enterprise
sources.locator: grep for rbac, organization, team member, sso, saml, presence, co-prompt, share across src, src-tauri/src
sources.finding: No multi-user accounts, roles, SSO or shared prompting; companion pairs personal devices.

sources.title: Bounded search: unattended triggers
sources.locator: grep for cron, schedule, webhook, trigger across src-tauri/src and sidecar/src
sources.finding: No scheduled or event-triggered agent runs; matches are UI/test internals.

sources.title: Bounded search: cost tracking
sources.locator: grep for cost, usd, spend, budget across src and src-tauri/src
sources.finding: Only context-window usage and provider rate-limit displays; no dollar cost, spend or budgets.

sources.title: Bounded search: native issue entity
sources.locator: grep for issue tracker, backlog entity, ticket across src-tauri/src/models and src/features
sources.finding: No native issue entity; status lanes label workspaces and the forge inbox reads GitHub/GitLab items.

sources.title: Bounded search: container or VM isolation
sources.locator: grep for docker, container, sandbox, vm across src-tauri/src and sidecar/src
sources.finding: No container or VM isolation; sandbox mentions are agent-SDK and Slack-scrape internals.

sources.title: Bounded search: hosted service and pricing
sources.locator: grep for pricing, subscription, billing, sign up, cloud across README, docs/user, src-tauri/src
sources.finding: No Helmor hosted service, account, pricing or billing; companion tunnel service uses Cloudflare.
